title: OpenAI Doubles Open Source Grants to 10,000 for $200 Pro Plan
summary:
Software maintainers are receiving upgraded access to premium artificial intelligence tools through an expanded grant program. OpenAI is awarding 10,000 subscriptions to its $200 Pro tier for the Codex for OSS initiative, which provides six months of ChatGPT Pro to recipients. Those who previously held grants are upgraded automatically, and the company is still accepting new applications.

The current offering increases the capacity of the program from 5,000 grants and raises the plan value from the previous $100 level. The project launched six months ago to provide modern software and tool ecosystems to the developers who maintain the foundation of global open source software.
